name: Catering Event Operations
audience: independent caterers and small event-food teams
topic: dietary confirmation and event-change control for caterers

products.name: Dietary Confirmation Register
products.product: A focused catering dietary and allergen confirmation workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent caterers and small event-food teams
products.problem: Dietary requests arrive through proposals, guest lists, planners, and last-minute emails, while kitchens need one approved interpretation tied to menu and service decisions.
products.valueProposition: Turns catering dietary and allergen confirmation into a visible operating queue so every declared dietary or allergen requirement is clarified, approved into the event plan, and communicated to production and service owners.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets catering allergy tracker, dietary requirements event, allergen catering checklist, and special meal register searches.

products.name: Event Change Cutoff Log
products.product: A focused catering event change control workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent caterers and small event-food teams
products.problem: Guest count, menu, timing, rentals, venue instructions, and staffing changes continue after proposals are signed, but affected teams may work from different versions.
products.valueProposition: Turns catering event change control into a visible operating queue so every accepted event change has authority, cost and production impact, an effective version, and acknowledgment from affected owners.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets catering change order, banquet event order changes, event change log, and catering production cutoff searches.
